title: carptotepala jenmanii
intro: Carptotepala jenmanii, commonly known as the Himalayan Carrot, is a plant species belonging to the Apiaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine and is valued for its various health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health and alleviate symptoms of fever and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Carptotepala jenmanii include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and carminative properties, which make it a useful remedy for treating digestive issues and fever. The bioactive constituents of Carptotepala jenmanii include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
